mission.title: Why OpenAEC?
mission.p1: The construction sector is one of the last major industries that still largely runs on closed, proprietary software. We want to change that.
mission.p2: The OpenAEC Foundation develops, supports and promotes open source software for the entire construction chain — from design to handover and management. Our goal: make the entire construction sector open source this year.

values.transparency_desc: Open code, open data, open processes. Everyone can look, think along and build together.
values.collaboration_desc: We believe the best software is created when the entire sector works together, not competes on tools.
values.accessibility_desc: No license costs, no vendor lock-in. Professional tools for everyone in construction.
